items.title_zh: 美国启动9月周年反倾销/反补贴行政复审：涉及中国钢制货架及耐火砖，非钢卷普遍加税
items.title_en: US initiates September-anniversary AD/CVD reviews including Chinese steel racks and magnesia carbon bricks
items.title_original: Initiation of Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Administrative Reviews
items.summary_zh: 【事实】美国商务部2026年11月5日发布《启动反倾销和反补贴税行政复审》（91 FR 69796，文号2026-22629），对9月周年日的多项现行AD/CVD命令启动复审。中国涉案产品包括钢制货架及零部件（Certain Steel Racks and Parts Thereof，A-570-088，复审期2025-09-01至2026-08-31）和镁碳砖（A-570-954，同期），并非中国热轧、冷轧、镀锌钢卷全面启动新调查。公告同时列有韩国冷轧板、韩国/墨西哥/土耳其厚壁矩形焊管等其他原产地产品。复审启动不等于最终税率改变。公告要求符合条件的非市场经济体出口商原则上于刊登后14个日历日内提交单独税率申请或认证；无销售通知原则上30日内；预计2027-09-30前公布终裁。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 5 Nov 2026 initiation notice (91 FR 69796; document 2026-22629) covers September-anniversary administrative reviews, including China-origin certain steel racks and parts (A-570-088, POR 1 Sep 2025–31 Aug 2026) and magnesia carbon bricks (A-570-954). It also lists Korea-origin cold-rolled steel and heavy-walled rectangular welded pipes from Korea, Mexico and Türkiye. Initiation is not a new blanket tariff or final rate change. Eligible NME exporters generally have 14 calendar days from publication for separate-rate applications/certifications, and no-sales notices are generally due within 30 days. Final results are intended by 30 Sep 2027.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对首钢冷轧、热轧及镀锌卷出口美国，不能由该公告推导新增普遍税负；重点检查是否直接或通过下游客户出口涉案钢制货架及零部件，以及相关企业是否被列名。被列名出口商应立即与美国贸易救济律师核对单独税率资格和申报期限。其他国家原产钢管/冷轧案仅在对应原产地及产品范围内有直接影响。
items.impact_en: Do not treat this notice as a new across-the-board duty on Chinese flat steel. Check direct or downstream shipments of covered steel racks and listed exporters. Affected exporters should promptly review separate-rate filing eligibility and deadlines with US trade counsel.

items.title_zh: 台湾地区研议本地CBAM及排放交易机制：钢材进口碳成本尚无正式新税率
items.title_en: Taiwan discusses domestic CBAM and emissions trading; no enacted new steel import rate confirmed
items.title_original: Taiwan plans to develop its own CBAM
items.summary_zh: 【事实】GMK Center 2026年11月4日报道，台湾地区当局正研究本地碳边境调节机制和排放交易制度。台湾环境主管部门2026年1月官方政策材料已说明正在规划借鉴欧盟的产品碳排放申报试点，水泥优先，并将与钢铁业讨论后续机制。现行对大型排放源的碳费与拟议的进口CBAM是不同制度；目前核验到的官方材料不构成已经公布对进口钢材征收新CBAM税率、正式生效日期或完整HS税号清单的证据。
items.summary_en: GMK Center reported on 4 November that Taiwan is considering its own CBAM and emissions trading framework. Taiwan's environmental ministry had already described a planned product-emissions declaration pilot in January, initially focused on cement and with steel-sector consultations to follow. Existing domestic carbon fees and a proposed import CBAM are distinct. The reviewed official material does not establish an enacted steel-import CBAM rate, commencement date or tariff-code scope.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】向台湾地区出口冷轧、镀锌、彩涂及其他钢材的企业应关注产品级碳足迹申报和后续进口碳成本制度，但现阶段不应在报价中直接加入未经公布的“台湾CBAM税”。可先准备产品碳排放核算与装置数据，等待主管部门正式草案、商品范围、豁免和时间表。
items.impact_en: Steel exporters should monitor product-level emissions declarations and potential future import carbon costs, but should not apply a hypothetical Taiwan CBAM levy to current quotations. Prepare auditable emissions data and wait for an official legal text, tariff scope and effective date.
items.status: 政策规划／尚非进口钢材新税

items.title_zh: 美国对华钢钉2024—2025年度反倾销复审初裁：悦达9.27%，9家企业终止复审
items.title_en: US preliminary AD review of Chinese steel nails: Yueda 9.27%; nine companies rescinded
items.title_original: Certain Steel Nails From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Results and Rescission, in Part of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
items.summary_zh: 【事实】美国商务部11月4日发布A-570-909行政复审初裁，复审期2024年8月1日至2025年7月31日。上海悦达钢钉及其滁州关联公司获单独税率资格，初步加权平均倾销幅度9.27%；中国统一税率118.04%本轮未复审、不变。因无可复审的暂缓清算进口记录，对附录II所列9家企业终止本次复审。案情摘要和名单均为官方初裁，并非终裁或对所有中国钢钉统一改税。公告规定利害关系方书面案情陈述须在公布后21日内提交，反驳陈述在此后5日内；听证申请应在公布后30日内通过ACCESS提交。
items.summary_en: Commerce published preliminary results for A-570-909 on 4 November 2026, covering 1 August 2024 to 31 July 2025. Shanghai Yueda Nails and its Chuzhou affiliate received a preliminary separate rate of 9.27%; the China-wide 118.04% rate was not reviewed. Nine companies were rescinded for lack of reviewable suspended entries. Case briefs are due within 21 days of publication, rebuttals five days later, and hearing requests within 30 days. These are preliminary findings, not final duty changes for all Chinese nail exports.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】涉美钢钉业务应逐家核实生产商/出口商身份、适用现金保证金和进口批次，不应把悦达9.27%用于其他钢钉企业；终止复审也不等于取消反倾销令。相关企业应在法定时限内由美国代理律师评估陈述、复核计算和听证；本次未独立取得ACCESS完整产品范围备忘录，具体HTSUS归类及适用边界须另行确认。
items.impact_en: Check exporter-specific treatment, deposits and entry history; do not apply Yueda's 9.27% to other exporters. A rescission does not revoke the AD order. Counsel should review briefing and hearing deadlines and verify product scope against the ACCESS memorandum.

items.title_zh: Isometric推出Ready for CBAM：为钢铁等六大行业提供排放数据整理与核验准备服务
items.title_en: Isometric launches Ready for CBAM emissions-data preparation service for six sectors
items.title_original: Isometric Launches New CBAM Data Preparation and Reporting Service for Exporters
items.summary_zh: 【事实】Isometric于2026年11月3日宣布推出Ready for CBAM服务，面向向欧盟出口水泥、钢铁、铝、化肥、氢及电力的企业，帮助编制装置级排放监测计划和排放报告，在正式核验前使用软件检查数据、由专家复核，并协助处理核验机构提出的问题。公司称Cementir已使用该服务。该服务是商业数据准备与核验支持方案，**不等于欧盟主管机关认可的独立核验机构资质，也不是欧盟新出台的CBAM规则**。欧盟进口商须为2026年进口货物在2027年9月30日前申报；使用实际排放值需要符合适用核验要求。
items.summary_en: Isometric announced its Ready for CBAM service on 3 November 2026 to help exporters in the six CBAM sectors prepare plant-level monitoring plans and emissions reports, detect data gaps and support the subsequent verification process. Cementir is an early customer. This is a commercial preparation service, not itself evidence of accredited independent verification or a new EU legal requirement. The first 2026-import CBAM declarations are due by 30 September 2027.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】中国钢厂可把此类服务视为准备监测计划、排放因子及证据链的工具，但须分别审查数据保密、核算方法、核验人独立性和欧盟认可资质。尤其不应把“Ready for CBAM”服务商的预审等同于最终核验报告；可将其作为现有第三方核验方案的备选，而非直接替换。
items.impact_en: Steel mills may use such providers for emissions-data readiness and audit trails, subject to confidentiality, methodology and independence checks. Preparation support must not be mistaken for final verification by an accredited verifier.
items.status: 商业服务发布／非新法规

items.coverage: 2026-11-04核对Isometric 11月3日公司原始发布及ESG Today、Agg-Net两家同期报道；已区分数据准备服务与法定独立核验，未审查Isometric或合作方的具体认可核验资质。
items.follow_up: 如拟采购该类服务，索取样例监测计划、核验工作界面、资质证明、数据安全协议及钢铁产品实际值核算案例；不把营销材料当作法规解释。

items.title_zh: 英国钢材贸易措施官方说明11月3日更新：20类配额、超额50%税及10月税号调整仍适用
items.title_en: UK steel trade measure: 3 November official page confirms 20 quota categories and 50% out-of-quota duty
items.title_original: UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国政府《UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026》官方页面标示2026年11月3日更新。该措施自7月1日起取代原保障措施，免税进口总配额较原制度减少51%，适用于列示的20类钢材产品；超配额进口加征50%从价关税，按其他进口税前货值计算，原25%保障措施附加税已于6月30日停止。按7月—次年6月配额年度分四季度，原产国单独额度及剩余（residual）额度按先到先得办理；季度未用完额度可向下一季度结转，但不跨配额年度。官方正文也明确此前10月1日起将非合金钢丝税号72173049、72173090排除在措施范围外，该两项由50%降为0%，第28类相关额度不变。最新页面仍列有第1类授权用途专用配额与对应下游加工用途。
items.summary_en: The UK government's steel trade measure page states it was updated on 3 November 2026. The measure replaced the former safeguard on 1 July 2026, cutting aggregate duty-free quota volumes by 51% versus the old safeguard and applying a 50% ad valorem out-of-quota duty to listed goods across 20 categories. Quarterly country/residual quotas operate first come, first served; unused amounts roll to the next quarter but not into a new quota year. A previously effective 1 October change removed non-alloy wire codes 72173049 and 72173090 from the measure, without changing Category 28 quota quantities. Category 1 authorised-use rules also remain set out.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对热轧、第4类金属涂镀、第5类彩涂及其他涉英出口钢材，应按英国8位税号、当季来源国/剩余额度和进口人实际报关时点计算配额风险。不得因11月3日网页标记更新而声称当天新推出50%税或上述10月税号调整；此次网页修订的逐项文本差异尚未取得。下一步核对HMRC实时配额余额、适用配额订单号及中国原产可用额度，再确定英国CFR/DDP报价中的超额税负。
items.impact_en: For UK-bound hot-rolled, coated and other scoped steel, check the exact UK commodity code, eligible country/residual quota and clearance date before pricing. The 50% duty was not newly imposed on 3 November; the 1 October wire-code exemption is also an earlier change. The full text diff for the 3 November page revision has not been established. Confirm live HMRC balances and quota order numbers rather than treating the published annual allocation as available stock.

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM 11月3日更新净重记录规则：以进口时不含包装的公斤净重申报
items.title_en: UK CBAM record guidance updated: net mass at import, excluding packaging, in kilograms
items.title_original: Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国HMRC 11月3日更新CBAM记录保存指南的重量章节。进口CBAM货物须记录进口时不含包装的净重，单位kg，最多保留6位小数。超过1kg且带小数的重量可按0.5kg阈值四舍五入到整数公斤；不足1kg应以0.开头、最多6位小数记录并去除末尾零。报关单、商业发票、运输重量记录、提单及装箱单均可作为重量证据。2027年1月1日起的进口记录义务、通常6年保存期及2028年1月1日开放注册的时间安排未因这次重量说明改变。
items.summary_en: HMRC updated its CBAM records guidance on 3 November 2026 to specify import-time net mass excluding packaging, in kg, up to six decimal places. Fractions above 1 kg may be rounded to the nearest kg with a 0.5 kg threshold; sub-1 kg values use up to six decimals without trailing zeroes. Import declarations, invoices, carrier records, bills of lading and packing lists can substantiate weight. Existing 2027 record-keeping and 2028 registration dates are unchanged.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】英国钢材订单需把轧厂卷净重、包装/托盘重量、提单重量及英国报关净重区分管理，避免将含包装毛重或船运重量直接用于CBAM申报。建议销售与货代对齐卷号级净重字段和公斤精度，留存原始称重与四舍五入记录；具体CBAM税额还需结合商品编码、排放强度及适用税率计算。
items.impact_en: Align mill coil net weights with UK customs net mass, keeping packaging and shipping gross weights separate. Retain traceable coil-level kg data and rounding records; weight alone does not determine the CBAM charge.

items.title_zh: 英国UK ETS免费配额技术指南11月3日清理过期2025基准数据收集材料
items.title_en: UK ETS free allocation guidance removes obsolete 2025 baseline data collection materials
items.title_original: UK ETS technical guidance: Free Allocation Regulation (FAR)
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国能源安全与净零部（DESNZ）于2026年11月3日更新UK ETS免费配额规则（FAR）技术指南。官方更新日志明确，本次删除了不再适用的2025年基准数据收集相关指导。页面继续提供UKETS11（装置级免费配额计算）、UKETS13（监测报告）、UKETS14（核验）、UKETS15（跨界热流）、UKETS16A（停产）、UKETS17（废气与工艺排放）及UKETS18（行业专门指导）等材料。更新日志未宣布11月3日新增碳价、改变钢材进口税率或即时改变英国CBAM适用范围。
items.summary_en: On 3 November 2026 DESNZ removed guidance relating to the obsolete 2025 baseline data collection from the UK ETS Free Allocation Regulation technical-guidance page. The remaining documents cover installation-level allocation, monitoring, verification, heat flows, cessation, waste gases and sector benchmarks. The update log does not announce a new UK carbon price, steel import tariff or CBAM product scope.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】主要影响英国境内UK ETS受管制钢铁及相关装置的免费配额申请材料管理，对中国钢材直接出口英国的CBAM义务并非一项新税。若客户在英国有轧制、镀锌或其他受UK ETS覆盖装置，应检查其内部引用的2025基准收集模板是否已过期；出口报价不应因网页更新就增加所谓新碳税。
items.impact_en: The change primarily concerns UK ETS installation operators' allocation documentation, not a new UK CBAM charge on imported steel. UK manufacturing partners should check for outdated 2025 baseline forms; exporters should not price in an invented new levy.
items.status: 官方技术指南维护更新

items.title_en: Canada starts expiry review RR-2026-008 of China carbon and alloy steel line pipe
items.title_original: Canadian tribunal opens review of China steel line pipe order
items.summary_zh: 【事实】加拿大国际贸易法庭（CITT）2026年11月2日宣布启动RR-2026-008到期复审，审查其2022年1月6日就中国碳钢及合金钢管线管作出的既有反倾销、反补贴命令若到期，是否可能再次发生倾销或补贴并损害加拿大产业。加拿大边境服务署（CBSA）最迟于2027年4月1日认定倾销/补贴继续或再发的可能性；如认定为肯定，CITT最迟于2027年9月8日作出损害可能性结论。有意参与者须提交Form I参与通知。该程序是对现有措施的到期复审，不是11月2日新征一个税率，也不是已决定撤销措施。
items.summary_en: On 2 November 2026 the Canadian International Trade Tribunal initiated expiry review RR-2026-008 of its 6 January 2022 order regarding dumping and subsidizing of carbon and alloy steel line pipe from China. CBSA must decide by 1 April 2027 whether dumping or subsidizing is likely to continue or recur. If affirmative, CITT must decide likely injury by 8 September 2027. Interested parties may participate by filing Form I. This is an expiry review of existing measures, not a new duty rate or a revocation.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】面向加拿大的中国管线管生产商和出口商应尽快核对现行措施适用的产品定义、生产商税率与出口记录，联络加拿大进口商/律师评估是否提交参与通知和证据。由于公告摘要没有列具体HS税号、公司税率和Form I截止日，不宜推断所有7304/7305/7306钢管均涉案，也不得擅自公布应诉期限。下一步阅读CITT正式Notice、CBSA产品定义与当前征税指令。
items.impact_en: Chinese line-pipe exporters should confirm product scope, producer-specific duty treatment and transaction history and assess participation with Canadian counsel/importers. The press release does not specify HS scope, company duty rates or the filing cut-off; consult the formal notice and CBSA instructions before declaring applicability or deadlines.

items.title_zh: 印度钢铁对欧盟出口量上半财年降19.8%，对美洲和非洲出口转增
items.title_en: India's steel exports to the EU fall 19.8% as shipments shift toward the Americas and Africa
items.title_original: India's steel exports to EU fall 20% amid CBAM, quotas; Americas surge 262%, Africa 96%
items.summary_zh: Moneycontrol按印度商务部数据分析称，2026/27财年4—9月印度对欧盟钢铁出口量由上年同期191万吨降至153万吨，同比下降19.8%；出口额由17.9亿美元降至14.8亿美元，下降17%。9月出口量同比下降50.4%至197,433吨，是二季度出口收缩的主要来源。同期对非洲出口量增长96%、出口额增长76.5%至3.342亿美元；对美洲出口量增长262%、出口额增长117.1%至14.2亿美元。欧盟2026/1384号条例及2026/1457号实施条例确认，7月1日起26类钢材年度免附加税配额总量为18,345,922吨，超配额附加税率为50%；但贸易数据本身不能证明印度某一产品配额已在9月耗尽，也不能把出口下降全部归因于配额或CBAM。
items.summary_en: Moneycontrol's analysis of Indian commerce-ministry data says April–September 2026/27 steel exports to the EU fell 19.8% by volume to 1.53Mt from 1.91Mt and 17% by value to USD1.48bn. September volume fell 50.4% year on year to 197,433t. Over the same period, volumes to Africa rose 96% and to the Americas 262%. EU Regulations 2026/1384 and 2026/1457 confirm an annual 18,345,922t quota across 26 categories and a 50% out-of-quota duty from 1 July, but the trade data do not prove that a particular Indian product quota was exhausted or that quotas and CBAM caused the entire decline.
items.impact_zh: 印度出口向美洲和非洲加速转移，可能增加中国钢材在这些市场的价格、交期和贸易救济竞争；中国出口商应按目的国、产品和季度跟踪印度流量、当地进口措施及自身利润，不能把印度总量变化直接套用于中国订单。对欧业务仍须逐产品核对欧盟季度配额余额、50%超配额附加税及CBAM产品排放数据；本条没有形成新的中国适用税率或配额。
items.impact_en: India's shift toward the Americas and Africa may intensify price, delivery and trade-remedy competition for Chinese steel in those markets. Chinese exporters should track flows by destination, product and quarter rather than extrapolate India's aggregate data to their own orders. EU sales still require product-level quota, 50% out-of-quota duty and CBAM data checks; this report creates no new China-specific rate or quota.

items.title_zh: 中国铁水产量降幅小于预期，铁矿石期价小幅反弹但四季度供应压力仍在
items.title_en: Iron ore edges higher as China's hot-metal decline proves smaller than expected
items.title_original: Iron-Ore Prices Rise After Sharp Declines as Chinese Demand Holds Up
items.summary_zh: 11月2日市场报道显示，大商所主力铁矿石合约在北京时间早盘上涨0.59%至679元/吨，新交所12月合约上涨0.61%至91.3美元/吨；此前两者在9月和10月均连续下跌。Mysteel样本钢厂截至10月29日的日均铁水产量环比仅下降0.2%至约232万吨，降幅小于市场对检修、亏损及北方环保减产的预期。国信期货认为价格接近支撑位后情绪有所恢复，但四季度供应过剩和钢厂盈利偏弱仍限制上行。同期上期所螺纹钢、热卷分别下跌0.59%和0.57%，不锈钢上涨0.34%。
items.summary_en: A 2 November market report said DCE iron ore rose 0.59% to CNY679/t and SGX December iron ore gained 0.61% to USD91.3/t after two monthly declines. Mysteel's surveyed daily hot-metal output fell only 0.2% week on week to about 2.32Mt as of 29 October, less than expected despite maintenance, weak margins and temporary northern output cuts. Guoxin Futures saw support-level stabilisation, while Q4 surplus risk and weak mill margins still capped upside. SHFE rebar and HRC fell 0.59% and 0.57%, while stainless rose 0.34%.
items.impact_zh: 本次反弹主要反映铁水降幅不及预期和技术性支撑，不能据此判断钢材终端需求或出口订单已转强。中国钢厂应把铁水、利润、港口库存和到港量共同纳入采购节奏，避免用单日DCE/SGX涨幅锁定中长期矿价；出口报价仍应基于钢材实际成本、汇率和目标市场贸易措施。
items.impact_en: The move reflects a smaller-than-expected hot-metal decline and technical support, not proof of stronger end demand or export orders. Mills should combine hot-metal output, margins, inventories and arrivals when planning ore purchases rather than extrapolate one trading session.

items.title_zh: 中钢协称自律控产降库存效果不及预期，将提醒约10家执行不力钢企
items.title_en: CISA says output discipline and destocking fell short and will remind about ten mills
items.title_original: Chinese Steel Group Chides Mills for Ignoring Output Curb Calls
items.summary_zh: 中钢协10月30日三季度发布会及《中国冶金报》评论显示，前三季度全国粗钢产量7.25亿吨、同比下降2.9%，折合粗钢表观消费量6.25亿吨、下降3.8%，需求降幅大于产量降幅；重点会员企业平均钢材库存1,685万吨，为近四年同期最高，9月会员企业利润总额22.4亿元、环比下降55.8%，钢铁主业亏损46.1亿元。中钢协评估约10家企业执行“以销定产、以效定产、以现定销”等原则不够坚决，将进行行业自律提醒，并要求控制生产节奏、降低库存。该安排是行业协会自律与经营倡议，不是政府下达的全国强制减产指标。
items.summary_en: At its 30 October briefing, CISA said Jan–Sep crude steel output was 725Mt, down 2.9%, while apparent consumption fell 3.8% to 625Mt. Key member mills' average finished-steel inventory was 16.85Mt, the highest in four years. September member profits fell 55.8% month on month to CNY2.24bn and core steel operations lost CNY4.61bn. CISA said about ten mills had not followed its sales-, efficiency- and cash-based production principles firmly enough and would receive self-discipline reminders. This is an industry-association initiative, not a mandatory nationwide government cut.
items.impact_zh: 若会员钢厂后续真正减产并去库存，短期可能缓解国内钢价和出口低价竞争压力，同时压低铁矿石、焦煤和焦炭需求；但目前没有统一减产量、企业名单或强制执行期限，不能据此推断供应必然收缩。中国钢厂应按订单、边际利润和现金回款安排产量；出口商需关注约11月7日海关数据、11月中旬10月粗钢产量及库存是否实际下降，再调整远期报价和原料采购。
items.impact_en: If mills actually cut output and destock, domestic and export price pressure may ease while raw-material demand weakens. No uniform tonnage target, named mill list or mandatory deadline exists, so supply contraction is not assured. Base production on orders, margins and cash collection, and verify customs, October output and inventory data before changing forward offers.

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM：HMRC明确实际值或默认排放值均可用于计算已付碳价抵扣
items.title_en: UK CBAM: HMRC clarifies actual or default emissions values for Carbon Price Relief
items.title_original: Work out your Carbon Price Relief
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国税务海关总署（HMRC）11月2日更新《Work out your Carbon Price Relief》。申请英国CBAM已付碳价抵扣，须证明进口货物的相关排放已受符合资格的碳定价制度约束，并持有涵盖进口前两个日历年度之一、经独立核验的碳价核验表。有效碳价按装置受不同碳价要素约束的排放量与相应价格加权计算，免费配额等无价格部分不计价，并扣除适用补偿。抵扣金额按有效碳价乘以符合条件的产品嵌入排放量计算；11月2日新增说明：该排放量应与CBAM申报一致，可按该批货物采用实际排放值或默认值。外币抵扣须使用HMRC公布的、进口前一季度适用汇率换算为英镑；总抵扣不得超过该批货物应缴英国CBAM税额。此为实施指南的解释性更新，并非宣布新增税率。
items.summary_en: HMRC updated its Carbon Price Relief (CPR) guidance on 2 November 2026. A claimant needs a qualifying carbon-pricing scheme and an independently verified carbon-pricing form covering one of the two calendar years preceding importation. The effective price accounts for differently priced emissions, excluding unpriced free allocations and deducting relevant compensation. The update clarifies that eligible embedded emissions used for relief must match the CBAM return and may use actual or default values as reported. HMRC's prior-quarter FX rate converts foreign-currency relief to GBP; relief cannot exceed the CBAM liability. This is guidance, not a new UK CBAM rate.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对拟于2027年起向英国出口钢铁的中国生产商，应提前整理装置碳价缴纳、免费分配、补偿及排放核验材料，并确认采购方/英国进口商能否取得合格证明；不能因中国有碳市场或采用默认排放值，就推定必然可抵扣。报价和合同CBAM条款应分别列示毛CBAM成本与可能抵扣额。下一步核对HMRC认可的碳定价机制清单、钢材商品编码及最终适用核验文件。
items.impact_en: Chinese steel exporters should compile verified installation emissions, actual carbon-price payment, free allocation and compensation evidence, and confirm the importer can substantiate a qualifying scheme. Default emissions values do not automatically establish an entitlement to relief. Price UK business on gross CBAM exposure and separately evidenced relief, subject to the applicable commodity scope and HMRC documentation.

items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国HMRC官方政策汇总的更新记录明确：11月2日修订集中在“如何计算已付碳价抵扣”（How to calculate CPR）图13的计算说明。政策汇总维持2027年1月1日启动英国CBAM、覆盖指定铝、水泥、化肥、氢及钢铁商品；CBAM负担原则上为嵌入直接排放乘适用英国CBAM税率，再扣除符合条件且有证据的已付碳价抵扣。申报可按规定使用经核验实际排放数据或英国政府默认值。11月2日更新不是宣布新增商品税号、税率或提前注册。
items.summary_en: HMRC's 2 November 2026 change log identifies an update to Figure 13 in the Carbon Price Relief calculation section. The policy summary retains UK CBAM commencement on 1 January 2027 for specified goods in aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen and iron and steel. The charge is based on embedded direct emissions times the CBAM rate, less eligible evidenced CPR; verified actual emissions or government defaults may be used. This revision does not itself announce new scope, rates or earlier registration.

items.impact_en: Model gross UK CBAM exposure separately from verified qualifying carbon-price relief. Do not assume full credit for Chinese carbon-market costs without checking eligibility and documentation. This entry records the policy-summary version change, not a separate new tax.

items.title_zh: 中钢协：中板增产491万吨、钢筋减产1718万吨，钢材结构继续向制造业调整
items.title_en: CISA: plate output rises 4.91Mt while rebar falls 17.18Mt as steel mix shifts toward manufacturing
items.title_original: 今年前三季度 我国钢铁品种不断调整优化
items.summary_zh: 央视网稿件经中新网转载显示，2026年前三季度中国粗钢产量7.25亿吨；中板产量同比增加491万吨，是增量最大品种，钢筋产量同比减少1718万吨，是减量最大品种。制造业用钢占比在2025年首次超过建筑业、达到51%，2026年上半年升至52%。同期钢材出口8564万吨、同比下降2.6%，出口均价709美元／吨、上升1.8%，进口钢材407万吨、下降10.5%。截至9月底，307家钢企完成或部分完成超低排放改造和评估监测，其中282家全过程完成、涉及粗钢产能约9.4亿吨；143家企业、7.5亿吨粗钢产能参加极致能效培育，三年累计节能超过2400万吨标准煤、减排二氧化碳6000万吨。
items.summary_en: A CCTV report republished by China News Service says China produced 725Mt of crude steel in January-September 2026. Plate output rose 4.91Mt year on year, the largest product increase, while rebar fell 17.18Mt, the largest decline. Manufacturing's share of steel use first exceeded construction in 2025 at 51% and reached 52% in H1 2026. Steel exports were 85.64Mt (-2.6%) at an average USD 709/t (+1.8%), while imports fell 10.5% to 4.07Mt. By end-September, 307 mills had completed all or part of ultra-low-emission retrofits and assessment, including 282 fully completed sites covering about 940Mt of crude-steel capacity. CISA's three-year efficiency programme involved 143 firms and 750Mt of capacity, reporting more than 24Mtce of energy savings and 60Mt of CO2 reductions.
items.impact_zh: 中板增、钢筋减以及制造业用钢占比上升，说明需求和产品结构正从地产相关长材向制造业板材、高性能和特种钢倾斜；钢厂应按真实订单、认证周期和产品盈利调整品种，而不是把协会数据理解为行政性品种配额。出口量下降、均价上升也不等同于所有企业利润改善。超低排放和节能数据是中钢协汇总口径，不能直接作为单厂、单产品的CBAM实际排放值或第三方核查结果；出口企业仍需建立产品级排放数据和可验证证据链。
items.impact_en: Higher plate and lower rebar output, together with a rising manufacturing share, point to a shift from property-linked long products toward manufacturing plate and higher-specification steel. Mills should adjust their mix against real orders, qualification cycles and margins rather than treat association data as an administrative quota. Lower export volume and a higher average price do not prove better margins for every producer. CISA's aggregate retrofit and energy-saving figures are not installation- or product-level CBAM actual emissions or third-party verification; exporters still need auditable product data.

items.title_zh: 英国钢贸会议预计2027年价格承压上行，CBAM与配额风险正进入合同条款
items.title_en: UK steel meeting expects 2027 price pressure as CBAM and quota risks move into contracts
items.title_original: UK steel industry expects higher prices in 2027; concerns that fabricated goods imports undermine safeguards and CBAM
items.summary_zh: EUROMETAL对10月22日ISTA与NSA利兹年会的报道显示，参会者认为英国钢市仍由供应主导、终端需求偏弱但未继续收缩，2027年价格可能上升。报道援引英国商务与贸易部截至10月26日数据称，热轧卷“其他国家”配额已用尽，印度8,364吨配额使用94%，韩国2,196吨配额使用20.3%，欧盟93,750吨配额已使用65,700吨。由于英国CBAM最终成本受核查和轧制料投入透明度影响，买卖双方正讨论成本分摊或事后调整条款；部分卖方转向DAP以限制超配额税费风险。参会者还担心制成钢品进口绕开上游配额并削弱CBAM效果，但该说法是行业风险判断，不是政府已认定规避或已经扩围。
items.summary_en: EUROMETAL's report on the 22 October ISTA/NSA meeting in Leeds said the UK market remained supply-driven, with weak but not contracting demand and expectations of higher 2027 prices. Citing DBT data as of 26 October, it said the residual HRC quota was exhausted, India had used 94% of 8,364t, South Korea 20.3% of 2,196t, and the EU 65,700t of 93,750t. Verification and input-transparency uncertainty is prompting CBAM true-up or risk-sharing clauses and some DAP offers. Concerns about fabricated-goods imports are industry views, not a government circumvention finding or enacted scope expansion.
items.impact_zh: 对输英钢材业务，2027年报价应把配额外关税、英国CBAM、核查失败和港口滞期费拆开列示，并在合同中明确DAP/DDP责任、适用配额时点、碳数据交付、最终税额调整及发票凭证。不能把会议上的涨价预期当成确定行情，也不能假定制成钢品已纳入现行配额或英国CBAM；实际报关前须按英国官方8位商品编码、实时配额余额和正式税率复核。
items.impact_en: For UK-bound steel, separate out-of-quota duty, UK CBAM, verification failure and demurrage risks, and define DAP/DDP responsibility, quota timing, emissions-data delivery and tax true-ups. Treat the price outlook as market opinion and verify 8-digit codes, live quota balances and enacted rates before customs clearance.

items.title_zh: 意大利铸造业协会称欧盟钢铁配额和CBAM造成上下游成本不对称
items.title_en: Italian foundry association says EU steel quotas and CBAM create an upstream-downstream cost asymmetry
items.title_original: Steel: Confimi’s Italian foundries take on Brussels – tariffs and the CBAM are hurting the supply chain
items.summary_zh: Eunews完整报道及Confimi Industria Meccanica声明称，参加帕多瓦会议的铸造和机械企业中“近30%”出现订单下降；协会认为，原材料钢进口超过欧盟配额后承担50%从价税，而部分半成品、铸件和下游部件未受到同等贸易防御或CBAM约束，造成成本不对称。协会主席Flavio Lorenzin还称，自2025年11月以来，碳钢、不锈钢和铝成本平均分别上升13%、16%和37%，并要求调整进口税、能源和监管成本，同时在CBAM谈判中纳入半成品、铸件和部件。官方交叉核对确认：Regulation (EU) 2026/1384自2026年7月1日起实施18.3百万吨年度免税配额及配额外50%税率；CBAM下游扩围仍是2025/0419(COD)立法提案，不能把协会诉求写成已通过规则。
items.summary_en: Eunews and Confimi Industria Meccanica report that nearly 30% of foundry and engineering companies represented at a Padua event had lost orders. The association argues that the 50% out-of-quota steel duty and CBAM leave some semi-finished goods, castings and components outside equivalent treatment, creating a cost asymmetry. It cites average cost increases since November 2025 of 13% for carbon steel, 16% for stainless steel and 37% for aluminium. Official checks confirm that Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 applies an 18.3Mt annual quota and 50% out-of-quota duty from 1 July 2026; downstream CBAM expansion remains proposal 2025/0419(COD), not adopted law.
items.impact_zh: 这是意大利行业协会的调查和政策立场，不是欧盟对损失订单、成本涨幅或扩围范围的官方认定。对中国钢厂而言，现行钢铁配额外50%税率已构成实际市场准入约束；同时，若未来CBAM扩大到更多下游制成品，原材料与部件之间的成本差可能收窄。出口商应按CN产品类别和配额余额核价，并跟踪2025/0419(COD)最终附件；不能根据协会发言预设半成品或部件已纳入CBAM。
items.impact_en: This is an association survey and policy position, not an EU finding on lost orders, cost inflation or final CBAM scope. Chinese exporters already face the 50% out-of-quota steel duty where quotas are exhausted. They should price by CN category and quota balance and monitor the final annex to 2025/0419(COD), without assuming downstream goods are already covered.

items.follow_up: 跟踪2025/0419(COD)三方谈判及最终CN附件，并核对欧盟各钢铁产品配额余额；协会所称订单和成本数据仅作行业样本信号。
items.coverage: 2026-10-31已通读Eunews英文全文并核对Confimi原始声明摘要；另以Regulation (EU) 2026/1384、Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1457及EUR-Lex程序2025/0419(COD)核对50%配额外税率和CBAM扩围法律状态。未获得“近30%”及13%/16%/37%的样本量、计算方法或企业明细，故只按协会陈述呈现。

items.title_zh: 港口库存升至1.5372亿吨，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨
items.title_en: Iron ore futures fall below CNY 680/t as port stocks reach 153.72Mt
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Lows on Rising China Port Stocks, Weak Mill Profitability
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月30日市场简报称，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨、接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，中国主要港口库存周环比增加近1%至1.5372亿吨，澳大利亚和巴西以外生产国发运维持高位，钢厂盈利比例为11.26%、与前一周持平。北方部分省份环保限制继续压低铁水产量，但限制解除后可能恢复；淡水河谷另报第三季度核心利润下降20%，归因于矿价走低及燃料、运费成本偏高。该文是即时市场报道，价格、库存和盈利比例并非官方统计序列。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 30 October that iron ore futures fell below CNY 680/t toward four-year lows. Cited industry data put major Chinese port stocks at 153.72Mt, up nearly 1% week on week, and the share of profitable steel mills at 11.26%, unchanged. Environmental curbs constrained hot-metal output in northern provinces, while Vale reported a 20% fall in third-quarter core profit. These are market-series figures, not official statistics.
items.impact_zh: 库存增加和低盈利比例说明矿价反弹基础仍弱，但单日价格不能直接证明钢厂利润将改善或必须减产。钢厂应同时看焦煤、焦炭、成材价格、库存结构和到港节奏，按采购窗口管理原料风险；贸易商应标明期货合约、交割月份和数据来源，避免把“接近四年低位”当作长期价格底部。
items.impact_en: Higher stocks and a low profitable-mill ratio point to weak support, but a one-day futures move does not prove margins will recover or mills must cut output. Mills should assess coking coal, coke, finished-steel prices, stock composition and arrivals together, and traders should identify the contract and data source rather than treat a near-four-year low as a durable floor.

items.title_zh: 宝钢股份前三季度归母净利润67.39亿元，同比下降15.33%
items.title_en: Baosteel's nine-month net profit falls 15.33% to CNY 6.739bn
items.title_original: Baosteel’s net profit fell by 15.3% y/y in nine months
items.summary_zh: 宝钢股份2026年第三季度报告显示，第三季度营业收入849.16亿元、同比增长4.75%，归母净利润21.67亿元、同比下降29.67%，扣非归母净利润19.61亿元、同比下降40.50%；前三季度营业收入2456.48亿元、同比增长5.68%，归母净利润67.39亿元、同比下降15.33%，扣非归母净利润64.93亿元、同比下降19.20%。前三季度铁产量3660.5万吨、钢产量3863.2万吨、商品坯材销量3915.0万吨、合并利润86.1亿元；出口接单量587.3万吨，同比增加70.4万吨。公司称单位铁水、物流、能源及质量成本同口径分别下降3%、6%、4%和16%。财务报表未经审计。
items.summary_en: Baosteel's unaudited third-quarter report shows Q3 revenue of CNY 84.916bn (+4.75% y/y), attributable net profit of CNY 2.167bn (-29.67%) and adjusted attributable profit of CNY 1.961bn (-40.50%). For January–September, revenue was CNY 245.648bn (+5.68%), attributable net profit CNY 6.739bn (-15.33%) and adjusted profit CNY 6.493bn (-19.20%). Nine-month steel output was 38.632Mt, saleable billet and product sales 39.150Mt, consolidated profit CNY 8.61bn, and export orders 5.873Mt, up 0.704Mt.
items.impact_zh: 收入增长但利润下降，说明吨钢盈利仍受钢价、原燃料及结构因素挤压；与此同时，产销量和出口接单增长并不支持简单推断宝钢正在减产。采购方和竞争对手应把5.873百万吨出口接单视为公司口径的订单量，而非已报关出口量，并继续跟踪第四季度交付、价格和库存。成本改善是公司披露的同口径指标，不能替代外部审计或推导单个产品利润。
items.impact_en: Revenue growth alongside lower profit indicates margin pressure, while higher output, sales and export orders do not support a simple production-cut conclusion. Treat the 5.873Mt figure as company-reported export orders, not customs-cleared exports, and monitor Q4 delivery, pricing and stocks. Company cost-improvement metrics are not an audit of product-level margins.
